about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

performThru grows only at a PERFORM nesting depth of 64; COADM01C nests at most 4 (runTask, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, SEND-MENU-SCREEN, POPULATE-HEADER-INFO / BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS)

`next >= 8` (past the last paragraph, p7) is never taken: every path ends in a RETURN / XCTL (Goback) before falling off a paragraph, and the last paragraph PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA itself ends with EXEC CICS RETURN, so no paragraph index 8 is ever produced.
MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE at MAIN-PARA's start: every task starts from initialState, where WS-MESSAGE is already spaces (WS-VARIABLES' image), and nothing writes it before this statement

MAIN-PARA's MOVE SPACES TO ERRMSGO is overwritten in full by SEND-MENU-SCREEN's MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO (80 bytes into 78) before the only read of ERRMSGO (the SEND MAP), and every path to a SEND goes through that MOVE.

Cobol.commarea(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, 161) makes the RETURN pass 161 bytes (the record plus the next byte of storage) where COBOL's RETURN COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) passes 160 (next EIBCALEN 160), in every scenario; the harness reads the RETURN area by the 160-byte layout and 'bytes past the layout are not compared on either side', so the extra byte / length is not compared.
COADM01C never references EIBRESP (the XCTL has no RESP; its failure goes through condition() on the translator's own result), so the store cannot show; DFHEIBLK is not compared.

the failed XCTL to the option's program: flipped, a failure skips condition(). For PGMIDERR the statements that follow are PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA's own (MOVE SPACES, DFHGREEN, the same STRING, SEND-MENU-SCREEN, the same RETURN), so it shows nothing; for any other condition an XCTL failing with a condition other than PGMIDERR (HANDLE CONDITION names only PGMIDERR) abends the task; no scenario has one: a fault scenario (XCTL NOTAUTH / INVREQ) would kill it, but the committed model port sends the menu instead of abending, and the det runtime knows no abend code for NOTAUTH -- both to fix before the scenario can join the case (tried in this PR, left out: #4648)

The tail of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY after the XCTL block runs only if the XCTL returns without a handled condition or the program is 'DUMMY'; no CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME is DUMMY (COADM02Y), a failed XCTL raises PGMIDERR (handler goes to PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA) or another condition (abend), and only EOC is ignored by default, so the fall-through to this PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN never runs.

The mutant moves 'COSGN00C' whenever CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM is not LOW-VALUES; it differs only when RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN is reached with another program name there. The PF3 arm sets COSGN00C first; on EIBCALEN = 0 the field is CARDDEMO-COMMAREA with no VALUE, whose contents IBM leaves to the STORAGE / WSCLEAR options (our image is spaces). Not stated equivalent: it rests on an oracle assumption, for the owner to rule.
